historical_target_limit: Contemporary observations cannot recover an immutable2026-07-28 configuration. Historical parity requires separately dated public artifacts; successful current recordings remain current observations.
interpretation_limits: No expected Global outcomes are invented: every scenario expected_global_result is null.
Positive and rejected outcomes must both be preserved; public source excerpts and before/after views qualify only visible behavior at recorded precision.
Public recordings can support net counts/balances and displayed item state, not hidden server atomicity, locking, durable persistence or concurrency guarantees.
An absent or hidden client icon, absent numerical target health, unknown version or missing resource view is a capture limitation, not a value.
